plain.text: "How long, LORD? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me? How long must I wrestle with my thoughts and day after day have sorrow in my heart? How long will my enemy triumph over me?"
"Look on me and answer, LORD my God. Give light to my eyes, or I will sleep in death, and my enemy will say, 'I have overcome him.'"
"But I trust in your unfailing love; my heart rejoices in your salvation. I will sing to the LORD, for he has been good to me."

summary.bigIdea: Even when it feels like God has forgotten him, David chooses to trust God's unfailing love.
points: David asks "How long?" four times; he feels forgotten by God.
He asks God to answer and give light to his eyes.
He ends by choosing to trust: "I have trusted in Your loving devotion."
summary.reflection: Can you pray this short psalm as your own prayer, starting with your own "How long?"
